display.purpose: The strongest reading anchor; contracts to 1.75rem on phones.

headline.purpose: Page heading; contracts to 1.5rem on phones.

observation.purpose: Open line spacing, preserved line breaks and a 70ch maximum measure.

motion.name: note-arrives
motion.purpose: Fade the saved observation background from pale blue to transparent; remove the animation under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Filled cobalt action for saving the current operation.
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #244d9e); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.375rem); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #244d9e); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; } .ds-primary { background: var(--blue, #244d9e); color: var(--surface, #ffffff); } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--blue-hover, #1b3c7e); }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Outlined action for entering the separate decision workflow.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #244d9e); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.375rem); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #244d9e); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; } .ds-secondary { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--blue, #244d9e); } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--blue-soft, #e7edf6); }

components.name: Text action
components.description: Quiet supporting actions such as Cancel and Clear filters.
components.css: .ds-text { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--blue, #244d9e); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.375rem); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #244d9e); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-text:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; } .ds-text { background: transparent; border-color: transparent; color: var(--blue, #244d9e); padding-inline: 0.25rem; } .ds-text:hover:not(:disabled) { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; }

components.name: Labeled search field
components.description: Native roster search with a visible label and strong editable boundary.
components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; gap: 0.45rem; color: var(--navy, #202c42); font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-search input { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; min-width: 0; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.65rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #a5b1c3); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.375rem); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--navy, #202c42); font-size: 0.8125rem; caret-color: var(--blue, #244d9e); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #59677d); opacity: 1; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #244d9e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Workspace navigation
components.description: Flat view buttons with a thin blue rule for the active view.
components.css: .ds-views { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dce2ec); } .ds-view { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.15rem; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #59677d); border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; } .ds-view[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--blue, #244d9e); color: var(--blue, #244d9e); } .ds-view:hover { color: var(--blue, #244d9e); background: var(--blue-soft, #e7edf6); } .ds-view:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #244d9e); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 45rem) { .ds-views { grid-template-columns: auto auto; gap: 0 1rem; justify-content: start; } }

components.name: Decision badges
components.description: Noninteractive status labels pair words with blue, green or neutral treatment.
components.html: Awaiting decision Placed Withdrawn
components.css: .ds-badge { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; display: inline-block; border-radius: var(--radius-small, 0.25rem); background: var(--blue-soft, #e7edf6); color: var(--blue, #244d9e); padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-badge[data-kind="placed"] { background: var(--success-surface, #edf5f0); color: var(--success, #286044); } .ds-badge[data-kind="withdrawn"], .ds-badge[data-kind="not-selected"] { background: var(--canvas, #f5f7fa); color: var(--muted, #59677d); }

components.name: Notebook surface
components.description: The flat workspace frame and continuous writing area, composed from the existing container and notebook styles.
components.css: .ds-frame { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #dce2ec); color: var(--navy, #202c42); font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-notebook { padding: 1.5rem 2.5rem 1rem; max-width: 58rem; margin-inline: auto; } .ds-notebook h2 { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.035em; margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-notebook p { color: var(--muted, #59677d); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0 0 0.875rem; } .ds-notebook strong { color: var(--navy, #202c42); font-weight: 600; } @media (max-width: 60rem) { .ds-notebook { padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; } } @media (max-width: 45rem) { .ds-notebook { padding: 1rem; } .ds-notebook h2 { font-size: 1.75rem; } }

components.name: Selected roster row
components.description: An entire player record is actionable; selection is a pale fill without an edge stripe.
components.css: .ds-player { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2rem minmax(0, 1fr) auto; width: 100%; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: center; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dce2ec); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; text-align: left; color: var(--navy, #202c42); cursor: pointer; } .ds-player:hover, .ds-player[aria-current="true"] { background: var(--blue-soft, #e7edf6); } .ds-player:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #244d9e); outline-offset: -4px; } .ds-bib { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--muted, #59677d); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-player-summary { display: grid; gap: 0.2rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-player-summary strong { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-player-summary > span { color: var(--muted, #59677d); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-player-summary .ds-roster-decision { color: var(--blue, #244d9e); font-size: 0.6875rem; }

components.name: Shared observation
components.description: Ruled note with an author, timestamp and a restrained arrival highlight.
components.html:
CSCoach SamApr 17 · 10:42 AM

Checks shoulder before receiving; confident turning into space.
components.css: .ds-observation { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--navy, #202c42); padding: 1.25rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dce2ec); } .ds-observation-heading { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; } .ds-author-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 1.875rem; height: 1.875rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--blue-soft, #e7edf6); color: var(--blue, #244d9e); font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-observation strong { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-observation time { font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--muted, #59677d); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-observation p { font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.65; margin: 0; max-width: 70ch; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-observation[data-new="true"] { animation: ds-note-arrives 650ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @keyframes ds-note-arrives { from { background: var(--blue-soft, #e7edf6); } to { background: transparent; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-observation[data-new="true"] { animation: none; } } @media (max-width: 45rem) { .ds-observation-heading { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 0.2rem 0.65rem; } .ds-author-mark { grid-row: 1 / 3; } .ds-observation time { grid-column: 2; } }

components.name: Decision choices
components.description: Native radio choices with a tonal selected state, stacking when space contracts.
components.html: Decision for Avery Morgan
components.css: .ds-decisions { font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--navy, #202c42); min-width: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; margin: 0; } .ds-decisions legend { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-choice { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #a5b1c3); border-radius: var(--radius, 0.375rem); font-size: 0.8125rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice:has(:checked) { background: var(--blue-soft, #e7edf6); border-color: var(--blue, #244d9e); color: var(--blue, #244d9e); } .ds-choice input { margin: 0; accent-color: var(--blue, #244d9e); } .ds-choice input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #244d9e); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 60rem) { .ds-options { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

narrative.overview:
A calm working notebook for coaches: white writing space, compact navy navigation, clear blue actions and observations separated by fine rules. Its density supports repeated reading and input on a field-side phone or a review desktop. Readable system sans-serif type and restrained controls keep names, notes and decisions easy to scan.

This records the implemented tryout workspace, not a global redesign of the legacy sample and account layouts. Shared tokens and controls live in [app.css](src/Pino/wwwroot/app.css); the dedicated [TryoutLayout](src/Pino.UI/Layout/TryoutLayout.razor) and adjacent feature styles establish this visual world. Product facts and open decisions remain in [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md); page composition, fictional content and session-only behavior are defined in the [feature brief](docs/features/tryout-evaluation.md).
keyCharacteristics: White writing surfaces on a cool, quiet canvas.
Cobalt actions and pale-blue selection against navy text.
Ruled observations and rows, with compact status labels.
One sans-serif family, explicit focus and responsive working space.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Color accompanies a readable status, selection state or feedback message; it never carries the meaning alone.

rules.name: The Ruled Paper Rule
rules.body: Separate repeated observations and player records with fine rules and spacing; keep writing surfaces flat.

dos: Do use the shared action, field, status and notice patterns with visible keyboard focus and explicit labels.
Do let long names and observations wrap, retaining reading and focus order.
Do use fine rules and tonal surfaces to organize repeated records.
Do preserve reduced-motion behavior and textual save feedback.
donts: Don't use color alone to distinguish outcomes or validation states.
Don't replace the notebook's reading surface with elevated cards or add a thick stripe to selected roster rows.
Don't treat the fictional club, sample roster sizes or account scaffold layout as approved product-wide identity or layout requirements.
